message.content:
Based on my search, **Procol Harum** was the first to sing "A Whiter Shade of Pale." The song was released as their debut single on **May 12, 1967**. 

The lead vocalist on the original recording was **Gary Brooker**, who was also the band's frontman, keyboardist, and co-writer of the music (along with lyricist Keith Reid and, after later legal proceedings, organist Matthew Fisher). The song became a massive worldwide hit, reaching number one in the UK and selling over 10 million copies.

While many cover versions followed quickly—including notable early covers by the Everly Brothers (August 1967) and the Box Tops (October 1967)—Procol Harum's original was the first.
